newsitem.title: FRANCE: NatMut kicks in 118 mln Ffr to Axa H1.
newsitem.headline: NatMut kicks in 118 mln Ffr to Axa H1.

text.p: National Mutual Holdings and its subsidiaries contributed 118 million francs to Axa-UAP's first half net income, up from 101 million for the same period in 1996, the French insurer said on Monday.

National Mutual reported a consolidated profit of A$175.5 million for the six months to March 1997. For Axa-UAP's financial statements, National Mutual accounts are consolidated under U.S. GAAP principles, Axa-UAP said in a statement.

Axa holds 51 percent of National Mutual Holdings. The contribution from Australian and New Zealand insurance operations in the 1997 first half was hit by exceptional adjustments for 58 million francs while the contribution from Hong Kong insurance activities was helped by continued business growth, Axa said.
